+           # "preset" (the default when omitted) keeps the names the route spec carries, so every service
+           # rendered from the same preset has the same rule names. "unique" appends
+           # "-<first 8 hex of sha256(<namespace>/<service name>)>" to every named rule; unnamed rules and
+           # routes referenced through spec.router.route.http.refs are left alone. Gateway API only requires
+           # rule names to be unique within one route, but Istio before 1.29.9, 1.30.6 and 1.31.2 keys the
+           # InferencePool endpoint picker by bare rule name across every HTTPRoute on a gateway, so services
+           # sharing rule names get scheduled by each other's endpoint picker; "unique" avoids that on such an
+           # Istio. A change reaches every service on its next reconcile and renames the rules of its existing
+           # HTTPRoute in place. A policy that targets a rule by sectionName stops applying until it names the
+           # new rule, and under "unique" that name differs per service. A service pins its own value with the
+           # spec annotation serving.kserve.io/route-rule-naming, which a preset may carry. Any other value
+           # marks every service without its own value HTTPRoutesReady=False (RoutingPreconditionNotMet)
+           # and leaves its existing HTTPRoute as it is.

+// validateRouteRuleNamingAnnotation sees only the service's own annotations. A
+// value carried by a preset is caught when the merged spec is validated at
// validateDisaggregatedSetAnnotation checks that the DisaggregatedSet annotation in
// spec.annotations is well formed. It lives in spec.annotations rather than the
// object's metadata so the presets that turn it on by default can set it.
+// ValidateRouteRuleNamingAnnotation is exported for the v1alpha1 validator.
+		{name: "absent defers to the ConfigMap", value: nil},
+		{name: "empty defers to the ConfigMap", value: ptr.To("")},
+		{name: "trimmed and case-insensitive like the consumer", value: ptr.To(" Unique ")},
+		{name: "unsupported value is rejected at admission", value: ptr.To("suffixed"), wantErr: true},
// (the default) or "regex", compared case-insensitively. Any other value
// fails config loading like the other ingress keys.
+	// RouteRuleNaming is "preset" (the default) or "unique", which suffixes the
+	// LLMInferenceService HTTPRoute rule names per service. An unsupported value
+	// sets HTTPRoutesReady=False on the services that use it.
+	// Not validated, unlike the other keys: a typo in this llmisvc-only key would
+	// fail every reader of the ingress config. The llmisvc router rejects it per
+		value string // omitted from the ingress JSON when empty
+		{name: "defaults to preset when omitted", want: constants.RouteRuleNamingPreset},
+		{name: "defaults to preset when blank", value: "  ", want: constants.RouteRuleNamingPreset},
+		{name: "normalizes case and whitespace", value: " Unique ", want: constants.RouteRuleNamingUnique},
+		// Rejected per service by the llmisvc router; failing here would fail every reader of the ingress config.
+		{name: "keeps an unsupported value for the router to reject", value: " Suffixed ", want: "suffixed"},
